description: Open-source two-stage (design/visualize -> render/test) game asset pipeline. Gaps below are the delta between this delivered baseline and a production-grade tool.
delivered: shared/assetFormat.js: asset+library+level schema, localStorage CRUD, JSON import/export
shared/voxelMesh.js: voxel -> InstancedMesh builder, sprite -> billboard Sprite builder
design/index.html: voxel editor (layered grid paint/erase) + sprite editor (pixel grid paint/erase), live 3D preview, palette, library list, save/duplicate/delete/import/export
world/index.html: ground plane, asset placement by click, placement select/delete, orbit camera, WASD pointer-lock fly camera, flat circle-collision against collidable placements, level save/load

tasks.desc: Replace per-color InstancedMesh in gfBuildVoxelMesh (shared/voxelMesh.js) with greedy-meshed BufferGeometry: merge coplanar same-color voxel faces into quads to cut triangle count for large models.
Add a vertex-color path so a single merged geometry can hold multiple voxel colors instead of one InstancedMesh per color.

tests.desc: Build a 10x1x10 solid-color voxel slab. Assert the greedy mesher produces 1 quad (2 triangles) per exposed face direction (6 total) instead of 100 boxes worth of geometry.
tests.how: In a Node or browser test harness, call gfBuildVoxelMesh on a synthetic asset, inspect the resulting BufferGeometry's index/position count.

tests.desc: Load a voxel asset with two colors in a checkerboard pattern and confirm visually/by vertex-color buffer that both colors render correctly with no missing faces.
tests.how: Open design/index.html, build a checkerboard voxel asset, verify preview render matches painted pattern.

tasks.desc: Replace circle-radius collision in world/index.html's collides() with per-placement AABB computed from the asset's actual bounding box (rotation-aware oriented box or conservative AABB).
Add vertical collision/step-up so the fly camera can walk onto low objects (e.g. stairs) and is blocked by tall ones, instead of always clamping camera.y to a fixed eye height.

tests.desc: Place a 1x1x1 collidable voxel box at origin; assert player cannot move camera position inside the box's world-space AABB from any of the 4 cardinal approach directions.
tests.how: In world/index.html fly mode, walk into a placed crate from N/S/E/W and confirm the camera stops at the box edge, not a circular buffer around it.

tests.desc: Place a voxel asset 0.25 units tall next to the player start; confirm the player can walk over it once step-up is implemented (no hard stop).

tasks.desc: Extend the Asset schema (shared/assetFormat.js) with optional per-voxel-face texture references (e.g. atlas UV rect) instead of solid fill color only.
Add a texture-atlas painting mode to design/index.html: let the user assign a small pattern/texture swatch (not just a flat color) to a voxel face.

tests.desc: gfValidateAsset() accepts a voxel asset whose voxels include an optional `tex` field alongside `c`, and gfBuildVoxelMesh renders the texture on at least the +Y face.
Create a textured voxel asset in the editor, export it, re-import into a fresh library, confirm the texture reference round-trips.

tasks.desc: Add an `actor` placement type (distinct from static placements) with a basic state machine (idle/wander/chase) driven by a fixed per-frame update loop in world/index.html.
Give actors a simple steering behavior (seek/wander) using existing placement AABB/collision data so they don't walk through collidable placements.

tests.desc: Place one actor asset with 'wander' behavior; over 30s of simulated time confirm its position changes and it never enters a collidable placement's bounds.
tests.how: Add temporary console logging of actor.position and collidable overlap checks each frame; watch console for 30s.

tests.desc: Unit test the steering function in isolation: given actor position, target position, and obstacle list, assert output velocity vector points away from any obstacle within avoidance radius.

tasks.desc: Define a minimal WebSocket wire protocol (JSON messages: join, placementAdded, placementRemoved, playerMoved) as a new shared/net.js module.

Wire world/index.html to broadcast local placement/camera changes over the protocol and apply remote peers' changes to the scene, without changing the single-player code path when no server is configured.

tests.desc: With a stub WebSocket server echoing messages, confirm a placement added in one browser tab appears in a second tab connected to the same room within 1s.
tests.how: Requires a WebSocket server implementation (explicitly out of scope per user preference to not solve env/network/host configs) — implement the client protocol only, leave server as a documented external dependency.

tests.desc: Unit test the message encode/decode functions in shared/net.js round-trip all four message types without data loss.

tasks.desc: Extract the pure-logic functions currently inline in design/index.html and world/index.html (paintVoxelAt, collides, approxRadius, gfValidateAsset callers) into shared/*.js modules so they're importable and testable outside the DOM.

Add a lightweight Node test runner (no framework dependency required — plain `node --test` using the built-in `node:test` module) covering shared/assetFormat.js and shared/voxelMesh.js pure functions.

tests.desc: `node --test shared/*.test.js` exits 0 with at least one passing assertion per exported pure function.
tests.how: Run `npm test` from the OPNassetBUILDER repo root.

tests.desc: gfValidateAsset returns a non-empty error array for an asset missing `kind`, and an empty array for a minimal valid voxel asset.
